Try a robust DBA combination on the full pool to see if iterative reweighting improves over simple weighted.
test a robust weighted combination over the full pool using inverse_error to see if full coverage improves over pool4.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust median over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers and correlated errors.
test a robust weighted combo using softmax_neg_error on the full pool to see if it outperforms median given strong seasonality and unstable rankings.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of outlier models and improve SMAPE.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a simple mean over a smaller, more stable subset (pool4) may improve robustness.
Ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture changing dominance across horizons.
Try a softmax‑negative‑error weighted combo on the reduced pool4 to see if a more aggressive weighting on the stable subset beats trimmed mean.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination using the top‑k‑mean‑per‑horizon handle (w7) on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific averaging beats the current trimmed‑mean leader.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable rankings; a trimmed mean on a reduced pool may reduce influence of outlier models.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9365. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.037); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.039.
